name: Joovy Car Seat Adapter – Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (Caboose RS/S & Qool)
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi / Cybex / Nuna footprint — the Clek Liing uses this footprint and is confirmed Liing-compatible on Clek's official stroller list.

priceSources.retailer: Joovy (DTC) — Caboose RS/S Car Seat Adapter (SKU 9121)
Joovy (DTC) — Qool Car Seat Adapter (front, SKU 9071)

install.pieces: single click-in adapter per position (front or rear)
install.notes: Click the connectors onto the stroller, then click the car seat in — no unbuckling. Qool double mode needs both a front (9071) and a rear Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna (9092) adapter. The Caboose RS/S adapter (9121) is NOT compatible with the older Caboose Graphite, Caboose Ultralight or Big Caboose.

notes: Clek lists a 'Universal Car Seat Adapter / Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna' for the Caboose S/RS and Qool. In Joovy's catalog these are the model-specific Maxi-Cosi/Cybex/Nuna click-in adapters: Caboose RS/S (SKU 9121, $39.90) and Qool front (9071) + Qool rear MC/Cybex/Nuna (9092), each $39.90. No printed Clek part number, so partNumber is null. Clek Liing (Maxi-Cosi footprint) confirmed compatible via Clek's official list.
